title: Bumblebee
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='wing' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#cfefff' stop-opacity='0.95'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8fd6ff' stop-opacity='0.85'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- far wing -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='30' rx='17' ry='9' fill='url(#wing)' transform='rotate(-28 60 30)'/>
  <!-- far legs -->
  <path d='M42 58 Q36 66 33 72' stroke='#6b4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 60 Q50 68 48 74' stroke='#6b4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M66 58 Q62 66 60 72' stroke='#6b4a12' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='48' rx='28' ry='22' fill='#ffd23a'/>
  <!-- stripes (clipped by ellipse shape via paths) -->
  <path d='M36 31 Q40 48 36 65' stroke='#2b2b3d' stroke-width='8' fill='none' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M52 27 Q56 48 52 69' stroke='#2b2b3d' stroke-width='8' fill='none' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M68 31 Q72 48 68 65' stroke='#2b2b3d' stroke-width='8' fill='none' opacity='0.9'/>
  <!-- body edge highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='48' rx='28' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#ffe98a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='44' r='14' fill='#3a3a55'/>
  <circle cx='20' cy='40' r='5' fill='#8f8fe0'/>
  <circle cx='19' cy='39' r='2' fill='#e8e8ff'/>
  <!-- antennae -->
  <path d='M18 32 Q14 24 10 20' stroke='#3a3a55' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M26 31 Q26 22 24 17' stroke='#3a3a55' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='10' cy='19' r='3' fill='#8f8fe0'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='16' r='3' fill='#8f8fe0'/>
  <!-- near wing -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='32' rx='20' ry='10' fill='url(#wing)' transform='rotate(-18 56 32)'/>
  <!-- stinger -->
  <path d='M80 48 L87 48 L80 52 Z' fill='#b9860a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M15 48 Q20 53 25 49' stroke='#e8e8ff' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
